fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s winter tourist season and attractions; complaints about fraudulent tropical fruit vendors; discussion of employment-bureau fees and other petty graft; coverage of disputes over city appropriations for major conventions (including the Elks and Shriners); and extensive reporting and opinion on the city finance/embezzelement case involving former city cashier W. A. Means, alongside political notes and Miami Beach Democratic Club announcements.
